title: Podcast EP366: How Cognichip is Changing Chip Design with Faraj Aalaei - Semiwiki
gist: In a SemiWiki podcast, Cognichip CEO Faraj Aalaei argues custom AI chips must be developed far faster to keep up with AI deployment, and that today's AI-assisted hardware design falls short because the models do not understand chip physics. Cognichip is building AI that solves design problems at designer-level cognitive ability, positioned as the industry's first full-stack intelligence infrastructure for chip design.

themes.theme: AI chip supply as the constraint on AI deployment

insights.claim: Cognichip CEO Faraj Aalaei argues there is a critical need to develop custom enabling AI chips faster in order to keep pace with the ever-growing demand created by AI deployment.
insights.speaker: Daniel Nenni
insights.so_what: If chip design cycle time is the bottleneck on AI buildout, tools that compress design schedules capture outsized value.
insights.quote: Daniel explores the growing impact of AI deployment with Faraj, who discusses the critical need to develop custom enabling AI chips faster to keep pace with ever-growing need.

insights.claim: Current AI-assisted hardware design has real shortcomings, chiefly that today's models do not understand the physics of chip design.
insights.speaker: Daniel Nenni
insights.so_what: It implies generic LLM copilots bolted onto EDA flows are insufficient, favoring physics-aware model builders over prompt wrappers.
insights.quote: Faraj discusses the shortcomings of AI-assisted hardware design today and describes the need for AI models that understand the physics of chip design.

insights.claim: Cognichip is developing a type of AI intended to learn, understand and solve design problems at designer-level cognitive abilities rather than merely assist a human designer.
insights.speaker: Daniel Nenni
insights.so_what: Designer-level autonomy, if achieved, would change EDA pricing from seat licenses toward outcome or capacity-based models.
insights.quote: Cognichip to develop a type of AI that learns, understands, and solves design problems at designer-level cognitive abilities

insights.claim: Cognichip is deploying its technology as what is described as the industry's first full-stack intelligence infrastructure for chip design.
insights.speaker: Daniel Nenni
insights.so_what: A full-stack infrastructure claim positions the startup as a platform layer competing with, not selling into, incumbent EDA vendors.
insights.quote: He explains that this technology is being deployed as the industry’s first full-stack intelligence infrastructure for chip design.

insights.claim: Cognichip is led by Faraj Aalaei, an entrepreneur with over 40 years in communications and networking technologies who founded and led two semiconductor companies through IPOs as CEO.
insights.speaker: Daniel Nenni
insights.so_what: A two-time semiconductor IPO founder at the helm raises the odds of institutional funding and credible customer access.
insights.quote: he was responsible for building and leading two semiconductor companies through IPOs as a founder and CEO
